title: 线上故障与应急响应
description: 覆盖告警确认、影响评估、临时止损、根因分析和故障复盘中的高频技术表达。

data.chinese: 监控在五分钟前触发了高错误率告警。
data.english: The monitoring system triggered a high error rate alert five minutes ago.

data.chinese: 这个问题目前影响所有移动端用户。
data.english: The issue is currently affecting all mobile users.

data.chinese: 我们先回滚最近一次部署来控制影响范围。
data.english: Let us roll back the latest deployment to contain the impact.

data.chinese: 数据库连接池似乎已经耗尽。
data.english: The database connection pool appears to be exhausted.

data.chinese: 请把相关日志和请求编号发到故障频道。
data.english: Please post the relevant logs and request IDs in the incident channel.

data.chinese: 临时修复已经上线，错误率正在下降。
data.english: The temporary fix is live, and the error rate is dropping.

data.chinese: 我们还没有确认根本原因。
data.english: We have not confirmed the root cause yet.

data.chinese: 这个服务需要增加超时和重试保护。
data.english: This service needs timeout and retry protection.

data.chinese: 恢复服务后我们会继续监控关键指标。
data.english: We will continue monitoring the key metrics after service recovery.

data.chinese: 明天安排一次无责故障复盘。
data.english: Let us schedule a blameless incident review for tomorrow.
